Court No. 29 CRM (A) 2571 of 2024  (266041)
 c  14.08.2024 In re: An application for anticipatory bail under Sec

the Code of Criminal Procedure corresponding   (AD 24) 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita  connection with Banshihari Police Station Cas  (S. Banerjee)
 2024 dated 25.06.2024 under   448/376/511/341/506/509/109 of the Indian Pen  Code, pending before the learned Chief Judici  (Allowed) Magistrate, Balurghat, Dakshin Dinajpur.
 And  In the matter of: Ajit Rabidas @ Tapas Rabidas  
 Ms. Jeenia Rudra  ... f  Mr. Arani Bhattacharyya  .
 Mr. Soham Banerjee  ..
 1.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. Considering the materials available in the case diary, the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. which does not contain the name of the present petitioner, the complaint of the mother of the present petitioner against one Bhramor Roy who was granted anticipatory bail by the jurisdictional court, we are of the view that custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not necessary.

3. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioner (Ajit Rabidas @ Tapas Rabidas)
shall be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs. 10,000/- with two sureties of like amount, to the satisfaction of the arresting Signed By :
SWARUP BANERJEE High Court of Calcutta 16 th of August 2024 05:51:16 PM officer and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, corresponding to Section 482(2) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Ajit Rabidas @ Tapas Rabidas vs Unknown on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131819375/
1 Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
4.
